worldcombat.skill.sandstorm.summary: Whip the ground into a scouring sand curtain: everything not Rock, Ground or Steel inside is ground down over passes and pushed downwind, Rock bodies harden their Sp. Def, and the sand it strips stays on the ground a while.
worldcombat.skill.sandstorm.use.0: Suppress foes without a stone body
worldcombat.skill.sandstorm.use.1: Grind a crowd inside the curtain
worldcombat.skill.sandstorm.use.2: Harden Rock bodies and shove formations apart
Press a sandstorm of radius %1$s blocks onto the chosen ground, lasting %2$s.
Each pass grinds %1$s of a body's max health and pushes it %2$s blocks; Rock bodies instead gain one Sp. Def stage from the grit.
Sand clings for %1$s after leaving. Pulses are %2$s apart.
Starts up in %1$s and settles in %2$s, both driven by Speed.
worldcombat.skill.sandstorm.timing: Cast at ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to raise the storm, recovers %3$s, and commits a %5$s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.sandstorm.growth.0: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sandstorm.growth.1: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sandstorm.preference.a: On = abrasive: wider curtain (x1.15), harder scour (x1.3), stronger drift (x1.35) and faster passes (x0.82), but shorter life (x0.78) and cooldown +16 ticks. Off = mild cover: smaller and lighter, but lasts longer (x1.22) and cools down 10 ticks sooner.
The companion only raises a sandstorm while a threat is within this distance; lower raises it up close, higher sets it up in advance.
Push the curtain at the foe
On, the curtain is raised between you and the threat so the fighting line falls in the sand; off, it is raised at your feet to shield yourself first.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to raise sand.
